status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 43% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 43 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces are securing the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have captured Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region and opposition fighters seized a third town in just over a week. The Somali government is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. Defence ties with Pakistan are deepening as Somalia seeks JF-17 fighter jets and has arranged the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from pirates. A presidential election is scheduled for May 2027. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene sikrer korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba etter harde kamper i Bay-regionen, og opposisjonskrigere har tatt en tredje by på litt over en uke. Den somaliske regjeringen screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og den er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten midt i økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Forsvarsbåndene med Pakistan utdypes ettersom Somalia søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og har ordnet løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra pirater. Et presidentvalg er planlagt til mai 2027. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
